ui_bugs.issue: Clicking [data-testid='open-bulk-import-btn'] (with event title set) does NOT render the modal. No [data-testid='bulk-import-modal'] appears, no [role=dialog] appears, no toast error visible. openCsvImport() in CreateVehicleMultiLotPage.js:608 attempts to POST /api/vehicle-multi-lot-auctions to create a draft stub before setCsvImportOpen(true). The backend draft-create works (verified in e2e test), so the failure is either: (a) the frontend POST is failing silently (start_time formatting from datetime-local), (b) the modal renders but BulkImportLotsCSV's dialog wrapper is missing the data-testid='bulk-import-modal' attribute, or (c) the modal state setter never fires. Main agent: add logging to openCsvImport catch block + verify BulkImportLotsCSV.jsx Dialog/DialogContent has data-testid='bulk-import-modal' at the root.

Cannot validate UI in headless preview env. Notification.permission auto-resolves to 'denied' on first load in this Chromium build, so the component's guard suppresses the prompt and writes localStorage.bidvex_push_prompt_v1='denied' immediately. This is likely correct defensive behavior, but the test case 'wait 6s after login → prompt appears with accept/deny buttons' is NOT exercisable here. Real browsers will behave correctly. Main agent: consider adding a dev override (e.g. ?force_push_prompt=1 query flag) or expose a console hook so QA can validate the FR/EN text + buttons without a real device.

rca_of_the_issue: Bulk Import modal stays closed because openCsvImport() (line 608, CreateVehicleMultiLotPage.js) creates a draft event via POST first, then sets state. Either the POST fails (no console error visible, only a generic toast that didn't appear in my run) or the modal's root DialogContent lacks data-testid='bulk-import-modal'. The backend draft-create itself works (e2e test confirmed). Most likely candidates: (1) BulkImportLotsCSV.jsx Dialog root missing the testid, (2) the start_time formatting throws Invalid Date in some locales, (3) draftEventId state leaked from earlier test. Main agent should add console.error in the catch block, verify the Dialog testid, and re-test in browser DevTools open.
